LanguageData.Apparel_RAGuards.label: Red Army Tunic - Guards Rifle
LanguageData.Apparel_RAGuards.description: Standard uniform for Soviet infantry. Thick cloth affords a fair level of comfort, as well as padding against blunt objects. Otherwise, this is nothing more than cloth, and affords little protection against bullets, artillery, or any other sharp instruments. This tunic bears a thick bedroll, containing a small multitude of tools and equipment within its folds.
